text.intro1: [excited] Good evening! I'm Kohaku, a fox
text.intro2: [shivers] Brr, it's cold… [cheerful] Let's make a fire first
text.intro3: [excited] Find something to burn, and a flint!
text.allset: [excited] All set! Strike the flint at the hearth
text.needBoth: [cheerful] First, something to burn and a flint…
text.needFlint: [cheerful] We need something to make sparks…
text.lightChest: [cheerful] Let's light the candle on the chest
text.candleFromFire: [cheerful] Let's light it from the hearth
text.warmCandle: [cheerful] Nice and warm. …There's a candle on the chest
text.springDeep: [cheerful] The hidden spring is deep inside the mountain cave
text.doorRight: [cheerful] Out the door on the right
text.dark: [nervous] It's pitch-dark out there. We need a light
text.gateA: [cheerful] The cave entrance. A stone door, and four candles…
text.gateC: [cheerful] Foxfire is my cousins' prank — a cold flame
text.gateD: [excited] Pick each candle and feel it with your ears!
text.wrong1: [surprised] Oh no — that was the true flame…!
text.coolBreeze: [cheerful] A cool breeze… there must be water inside
text.tunnel2: [whispers] Listen — go toward the sound of water
text.dead2: [cheerful] Back we go — the water is the other way
text.blowLight: [cheerful] Hey — try blowing out your light
text.see: [excited] See? This is the hidden spring!
text.thanks: [excited] Thank you for coming with me!
text.h_find1: [cheerful] Look in the basket and the chest's drawers
text.h_strike: [excited] Tap the hearth to strike the flint
text.h_ember: [cheerful] Blow into the mic — or hold the Blow button
text.h_candle1: [cheerful] Take the candle on the chest, then tap the fire
text.h_candle2: [cheerful] Once it is lit, go out the door on the right
text.h_gate1: [cheerful] Pick each candle and feel it — the warm one is real
text.h_gate2: [cheerful] Foxfire chimes like glass… and looks a little blue
text.h_fork1: [cheerful] Go where the water sounds and the cool air come from
text.h_fork2: [cheerful] Look closely — the water side glows faintly blue
